ns2:section.sectionText: ADVANCES IN TERRISTRIAL ECOSYSTEM REMOTE SENSING: This is an advanced course applying satellite remote sensing (RS) to terrestrial environmental issues. The course begins March 17, meets weekly for 8 weeks, and follows a lecture and in-class discussion format. Students will gain a deep understanding of the physical mechanisms of remote sensing technology as well as the scientific contexts of how to best utilize remote sensing technology to address questions in natural resources, hydrology, and environmental monitoring. The course does not require prior knowledge of remote sensing.
